description: This file defines the WorkerPoolImplementation class, which inherits from WPEFramework's Core::WorkerPool and Core::ThreadPool::ICallback. It includes a nested Dispatcher class implementing the IDispatcher interface, and manages thread pool behavior including construction, destruction, and dispatching jobs.

classes.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
classes.description: A class that implements a worker thread pool with a nested Dispatcher class for job dispatching, managing thread pool lifecycle.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: A nested class within WorkerPoolImplementation that implements the IDispatcher interface to handle job dispatching.

methods.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the thread pool with specified stack size and starts it.

methods.name: ~WorkerPoolImplementation
methods.description: Destructor that stops the thread pool.

methods.name: Idle
methods.description: Method intended to perform idle-time activities; currently empty.
